results.title: Wolf Coat
results.overview: A lamb and a young wolf grew up together from childhood, but one stormy night, they were attacked by a vicious wolf that had been stalking them. Though the lamb and the young wolf survived, the wolf was left with a scar in its heart. To protect the lamb, the wolf began to devour other animals to become stronger. However, in the process, the wolf's true nature gradually changed.

results.title: Eastern White
results.overview: This Short Animated film is a personal project that aims to make the viewer experience a glimpse into the feelings, emotions and experiences that an Eastern European immigrant experiences. It is specifically about my memories, encounters, and personal bruises that I have encountered as a Romanian living and growing within UK through all the political shifts that Brexit, a pandemic and neighbouring war within my homeland. I made this film as a form of processing, healing and honouring the growth and the hardship that came with and due to changes in how I was perceived and affected due to phisically shifting environments and states of being or expressing myself.

results.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Rise Of The Turtles
results.original_title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Rise Of The Turtles
results.overview: On their 15th birthday, the four mutant turtle brothers—Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello, and Michelangelo—are finally permitted by their mentor, Master Splinter, to leave their sewer home and explore the surface of New York City for the very first time. While adjusting to the dazzling but chaotic human world, they witness a teenage girl named April O'Neil and her scientist father being abducted by a secretive, brain-like alien race known as the Kraang. To rescue them, the brothers must quickly learn to move past their sibling rivalries, master their ninja teamwork, and weaponize their skills against advanced alien technology—an adventure that inadvertently alerts their ultimate nemesis, The Shredder, to their existence.

results.title: Samburai
results.overview: Samburai follows a lone red gummy bear samurai who stumbles upon a tragic scene: his fellow red gummy bear lies dead, surrounded by the orange-yellow cult responsible for the slaughter. Unmoved by fear and stripped of emotion, the Samburai draws his blade and systematically executes every member of the cult in a ruthless, unyielding quest for revenge.  As the body count rises, the lighting shifts progressively toward a deep, suffocating red—visually drowning out the characters' original hues until attacker and victim become indistinguishable. With the last enemy slain, the Samburai is left standing alone in the blood-red light, devoid of purpose and consumed by the very destruction he wrought.
